ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Five sparrows on a rope look in one or the other direction (see diagram). Every sparrow whistles as many times as the number of sparrows he can see in front of him. Azra therefore whistles four times. Then one sparrow turns in the opposite direction and again all sparrows whistle according to the same rule. The second time the sparrows whistle more often in total than the first time. Which sparrow has turned around?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the five sparrows are labeled from left to right as Azra, Bernhard, Christa, David, Elsa. Their orientations are respectively: Azra faces right, Bernhard faces left, Christa faces right, David faces left, Elsa faces left. Reasoning: The number of times each sparrow whistles is equal to the number of sparrows it can see in the direction in front of it. Initially, Azra faces right and sees 4 on the right, so whistles 4 times; Bernhard faces left and sees 1 on the left; Christa faces right and sees 2 on the right; David faces left and sees 3 on the left; Elsa faces left and sees 4 on the left. The initial total is 4 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 14. Now test one by one the total after only one sparrow turns around: after Azra turns around, it changes from 4 to 0, total 10; after Bernhard turns around, it changes from 1 to 3, total 16; after Christa turns around, it changes from 2 to 2, total 14; after David turns around, it changes from 3 to 1, total 12; after Elsa turns around, it changes from 4 to 0, total 10. Only Bernhard turning around will make the second total number of whistles greater than the first time.

From the text, each sparrow whistles the number of sparrows in the direction it faces, and after exactly one sparrow turns, the total number of whistles is larger. Compute the initial whistles from the diagram: Azra sees 4, Bernhard sees 1, Christa sees 2, David sees 3, Elsa sees 4, total 14. Then test each possible single turn by changing only that bird's direction and recomputing the total. Turning Azra gives 10, Bernhard gives 16, Christa gives 14, David gives 12, Elsa gives 10. The only turn that makes the total larger is Bernhard's, so the turned sparrow is Bernhard.
